exposure: information about the need to get vaccinated
reasons for refusing influenza vaccination (fear of adverse events, not necessary, not at risk)
cohort: The study included 304 pregnant women in Greece with a mean age of 31.5 years and a mean gestational age of 27.8 weeks.
finding: An educational intervention was associated with an influenza vaccination rate of 19.5% among pregnant women, with previous influenza vaccination and information about the need to get vaccinated being significant factors for uptake.
cross-section timing: During pregnancy, following an educational intervention
gest_age: Mean gestational age of 27.8 weeks (SD: 9.6 weeks) for the cohort, and 24.6 weeks (SD: 7.5 weeks) for vaccinated women
